title: GLM-5.3-Flash on four Sparks
evidence_scope: MTP3 with native prefix caching, a 1,048,576-token context window and, for the nvfp4-spark checkpoint, the default on an image that cannot read csf, 40 GiB of KV cache per Spark in 1,024-token pages. On installer image dev-20260928-plainstatus-cuda1342-nccl2323-status033, the deployment reported 6,128,169 KV tokens (performance/records/images/dev-20260928-plainstatus-glm53-flash-tp4-20260929.md); image, video and text memory loads on that image are in performance/records/glm53-flash/installer-memory-20260929.md. On installer image dev-20261001-kraken-cuda1342-nccl2323-status034, an installation through install.sh on one four-Spark ring passed 7 of 7 functional checks (counting, arithmetic, code, tool calls, image, thinking) and a 256-request correctness screen with no degenerate response, and decoded 65.7 / 211 / 290 tokens/s at 1 / 8 / 16 streams at temperature 1.0 with 64K-token prefill at 3,666 tokens/s (performance/records/images/dev-20261001-kraken-glm53-flash-nvfp4-spark-tp4-20261001.md). On installer image dev-20261004-kraken-cuda1342-nccl2323-status034, an installation through install.sh on one four-Spark ring passed 7 of 7 functional checks and a 256-request correctness screen with no degenerate or failed response, and decoded 65.3 / 205 / 280 tokens/s at 1 / 8 / 16 streams at temperature 1.0 with 64K-token prefill at 3,525 tokens/s, medians of two runs (performance/records/images/dev-20261004-kraken-glm53-flash-nvfp4-spark-tp4-20261004.md). The csf checkpoint (local-inference-lab/GLM-5.3-Flash-NVFP4-MXFP8-CSF-QAD at dec48abd33ef), which the installer installs without --checkpoint on an image whose vLLM is SIRCL's pinned build sparkring-kraken-beta-20261007-bc9ea774, with --quantization nvfp4_csf, --load-format nvfp4_csf, W4A16 decode, the draft's experts on marlin and 37 GiB of KV cache per Spark, as the eight-Spark profile glm53-flash-csf-tp8 sets them, is research-only: no installation of it has run. Timings on earlier images are single runs; not serving-qualified. Its csf checkpoint runs small-M W4A16 experts with two CTAs per SM (B12X_W4A16_SMALL_M_OCCUPANCY=2). With it and with SIRCL's ring schedules for large all-reduces, all-gathers and reduce-scatters with a 64 KiB one-shot limit and 1 MiB link pieces and slot, set at the container level; an installer deployment takes them from the pair and path-4 rows of SparkRing's default SIRCL tuning table, which apply to SIRCL 0.3.1 sessions, so on images with SIRCL 0.3.0, such as 816c6d6a7e96 and af06e2727b6a, it runs without them, the csf checkpoint on SIRCL on a path of four Sparks of a ring of eight, on image 816c6d6a7e96 (lock dev-20261008-kraken-csf-sircl-libsircl-cu1342-nccl2323-status034) with GPU clocks locked at 2,418 MHz, measured 25.0 / 82.5 decode steps/s at 1 / 8 streams through the serving A/B runner (performance/records/images/dev-20261008-kraken-csf-sircl-libsircl-tp2-tp4-matrix-20261009.md); no installation with these settings has run.
